title: Data Consistency and Idempotent Operations knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which approach best supports reliable work with Data Consistency and Idempotent Operations?
options: Make trade-offs explicit, design idempotent boundaries, and add service separation only when it solves a demonstrated need.
Skip input validation because Node.js applications run on a trusted server.
Assume every supported runtime has identical APIs and scheduling behavior.
Store credentials and production secrets directly in the source file.
questions.answer_key: Make trade-offs explicit, design idempotent boundaries, and add service separation only when it solves a demonstrated need.
questions.explanation: Make trade-offs explicit, design idempotent boundaries, and add service separation only when it solves a demonstrated need. The example and verification steps should make this practice observable.

questions.prompt: Before relying on a Data Consistency and Idempotent Operations implementation, what verification is most useful?
